Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized read access to a subset of Oracle WebCenter Content accessible data. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 3.1 (Confidentiality impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N).

items.desc: Vulnerability in the iProcurement product of Oracle E-Business Suite (component: E-Content Manager Catalog).  Supported versions that are affected are 12.2.3-12.2.15. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows high privileged attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise iProcurement.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of iProcurement. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 7.2 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H).
